description: Feeds a campaign from a market or social signal monitor, or stops every signal with monitorId null. Without add or replaces the monitor becomes the campaign's only signal. A campaign takes up to 5 signals: add true keeps the others and adds this one; replaces (a monitorId the campaign has) puts this one in its place and pauses the old one when no other campaign reads it. Each day the campaign's daily additions take the companies the signals delivered and write to one person at each: the person the monitor already found, a store's owner, or jobTitle searched at the company (required unless the monitor is about online stores or the campaign already has a job title; with add the campaign keeps its own). People are added, and charged, at the campaign's daily people limit. On an active campaign, add or replaces turns the signal on and it spends credits every day: the first call returns status quote with the monthly credit ceiling and changes nothing; the call with confirmed true applies it. Only a workspace owner or admin can change it.

add.description: true: keep the campaign's other signals and add this one.

confirmed.description: true only after the user agreed to the monthly cost a quote returned.

replaces.description: A signal of the campaign that this monitor takes the place of.

name: set_campaign_signal_monitor
